briefing.headline: Anthropic's record IPO has not lifted AI and chip stocks, and Asian tech markets fell sharply on Friday after the US sell-off.

points.text: Anthropic's IPO was the biggest on record. It sold 930 million shares at $83 each.
points.label: reported

points.text: Anthropic shares rose in the debut, but the rest of the market fell. All four major US indexes were on pace for their worst week since April 2025.
points.label: reported

points.text: Asian tech stocks fell on Friday. The Nikkei slid about 4% and dipped below 57,000. SoftBank fell over 16%.
points.label: reported

points.text: Nvidia's interim CEO Colette Kress said customer demand is still growing. She said the company's customer base remains broad.
points.label: reported

points.text: Nvidia reports results after the US close on Tuesday, about 1:20am Wednesday in Dubai. Expected numbers are not in the material.
points.label: reported
